description: This file defines the ConciergeForwarderActor class, an Akka actor responsible for forwarding signals to either a dispatcher or an enforcer within the Concierge service, depending on whether the signal has an entity ID. It manages message routing, subscription acknowledgment logging, and can transform signals before forwarding.

classes.name: ConciergeForwarderActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that forwards signals to either the addressable enforcer or dispatcher based on signal content, supporting signal transformation and subscription handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for actor instantiation with a default or custom signal transformer.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for incoming messages, including Signal, subscription acknowledgment, and unknown messages.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Routes a Signal either to pub/sub mediator or to the enforcer actor, applying signal transformation if needed.

methods.name: wrapForPubSub
methods.description: Helper method to create a pub/sub message wrapper.
